arXiv:2609.12020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key subtask of quantum error correction is to extract a syndrome that, if nontrivial, signals an error. In this paper, we use reinforcement learning and importance sampling to outperform previous work at all scales. item.title: Hund’s physics-driven strong correlation in the altermagnet CaCrO3
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zhenfeng Ouyang, Peng-Jie Guo, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu
Altermagnetism has attracted intense interest, but strong correlation effects in altermagnets remain largely unexplored. Here, using density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT), we identify CaCrO3, a rare example of a metallic altermagnet, as a Hund altermagnet. We show that Hundness, rather than Mottness, leads to incoherent metallicity with altermagnetic spin splitting and sustains local spin moments. The DFT+DMFT calculated magnetic moment (~ 1.3 µB/Cr) is in quantitative agreement with neutron diffraction (~ 1.2 µB/Cr), while conventional DFT + U predicts an insulating state instead. Furthermore, Hundness promotes incipient flat bands and gives rise to heavy-fermion-like behavior in this 3d system, with effective mass enhancement m*/m ~ 47. This work demonstr…

item.title: Laser-induced metastable (anti-)skyrmion states with higher-order topological charge
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tim Titze, Marcel Möller, Timo Schmidt, Mariam Hassan, Sabri Koraltan, Stefan Mathias 等9位作者
arXiv:2609.13112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast creation and manipulation of topologically non-trivial spin objects promises significant potential for spintronic applications. Here, we demonstrate laser-induced nucleation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions with topological charge up to |Q|=3 from the saturated magnetization state of a Co/Ni-multilayer which does not intrinsically host a skyrmionic ground state. The resulting configuration of spin objects thus constitutes a metastable, thermodynamically hidden magnetic state. We control the number and type of spin objects by the excitation fluence and the external out-of-plane magnetic field.

item.title: 用于高通量识别蜂窝材料的几何方法
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lex M. Rouquette, Alannah M. Hallas
研究提出了一种基于简单几何论证的筛选算法，用于从材料数据库中识别具有蜂窝结构基元的材料。作者将晶格分为常规蜂窝、超蜂窝、阶梯或之字形蜂窝以及完全三维蜂窝四类，并进一步识别出伸长、剪切和翘曲等畸变模式。研究还提出了用于评估二维材料可剥离性、识别磁性蜂窝以及筛选电子不稳定性的指标，为目标物理现象的材料发现和实验表征提供数据库工具。

item.title: Ammann-Beenker 人工自旋冰中的内禀激发与一种拟议基态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 E Weightman, L O'Brien, S Coates
该研究考察基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的准周期人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型提供了周期晶格中不存在的局域环境。作者结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟和单个顶点能量的微磁计算，发现顶点冻结顺序并非由配位数决定，而由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。研究还提出一种解析基态，由长程有序的固定自旋网络与稀疏简并区域共同构成。

arXiv:2603.12330v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay of antiferromagnetic order, momentum-dependent Bloch spin-splitting, time-reversal (T), and parity (P) symmetries in non-relativistic systems has emerged as a central theme for spintronics. Two well-known examples are P-preserving and T-violating altermagnets and P-violating and T-preserving odd-parity magnets. item.title: NEMO：用于弯曲和多层生物表面的向列与形态分析框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Konstantinos Andreadis, Oriol Mañé-Benach, Claire A. Dessalles, Lodovico Mazzei, Aurélien Roux, Guillaume Salbreux
该工作提出 NEMO，一个用于深度分辨量化切向向列有序和表面形态的模块化 Python 框架。NEMO 将生物表面重构为三角网格，投影弯曲强度层，提取局域向列指向矢，并在切平面内计算局域平均向列张量。该框架还可识别拓扑缺陷、计算拓扑荷，并量化表面间距离及曲率，作者通过合成囊泡向列膜和 Hydra 中的肌动蛋白组织展示了其能力。
